Team,

Quick note — Ethan Morris (ex-TrenchAI) just confirmed a firm competing offer from CoreScale with a decision deadline next Tuesday 8/29. He is highly interested in Redwood but asked us to move fast; he also flagged a visa/relocation window (needs DS-160 / COS paperwork started before mid-September to meet his current timeline).

Key candidate facts:
- Role: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (IC4-equivalent)
- Notice period: 4 weeks (can start earlier if we provide bridging/flexible start)
- Counter? CoreScale has increased their base by $15k and offered a small sign-on.

Ask: can Recruiting + Comp team get me a firm offer packet to send today? Hiring manager (Jonas) — confirm top-of-band for base and equity tolerance. Aditya — would we approve a one-time sign-on up to $20k and an equity uplift of ~0.15% above band if needed? Finance/legal will need to prep the DocuSign link; I can ping candidate as soon as we have numbers.

I attached Ethan's last CV and a quick note he shared.

Thanks,
Hannah

- Equity: standard grants for role cluster are 0.35%–0.55%; exceptions up to 0.65% require Director approval.

Subject: Redwood Inference — Formal Offer (senior infra engineer)

Ethan —

Thanks again for the conversations last week. We're excited to extend a formal offer for Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Redwood Inference. Summary (formal packet attached / DocuSign link below):

- Base: $220,000/year
- Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 0.55% (standard 4-year vest)
- Relocation & visa support: Redwood will cover reasonable visa-related legal fees and provide relocation assistance; we'll offer bridging pay for up to 2 weeks if start is delayed due to paperwork.

We need a decision by 48 hours (EOD 2028-08-24 12:00 PDT) because we have competing timelines. If you need alternate timing for a visa-based start, let me know; we are open to a flexible start date but need a signed offer to reserve the grant and compensation package.

Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Formal Offer (senior infra engineer)

Hannah —

First, really appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear visa/relocation support — that matters. I did want to flag two items before I sign:

1) CoreScale increased their base by $15k (to $235k) and gave a $15k sign-on.
2) Equity: 0.55% is great; given my current equity situation at TrenchAI I'd like to ask if Redwood could consider an additional 0.10% (to 0.65%) or a restricted stock refresh 12 months in.

If neither is possible, could Redwood match the $235k base or increase the sign-on by an additional $10k? My preference is to join Redwood — the team and problems are a better fit — but I need a little more runway on comp to make the move given relocation and visa risk.

Also attaching a short counter-proposal so we have the asks documented. I can decide within 24 hours if we can land somewhere in the middle.

Thanks,
Ethan

Proposed final concessions (to land candidate):
- Increase sign-on to $30,000 (one-time) and keep base at $220,000; OR
- Increase base to $230,000 (+$10k) and keep sign-on $20,000; AND
- Add a 12-month performance-based refresh (0.05%) if we can't get to 0.65% immediate grant.

Aditya — can we approve either path? Jonas — do you prefer higher base or higher sign-on from a budget/team perspective? If we approve, I will update the DocuSign packet and push for same-day sign.

Thanks,
Hannah
